from collections import deque
H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(H):
 for c in range(W):
  if grid[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.pop(); pts.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
      seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
   comps.append(pts)
[(len(p),(min(x for x,y in p),max(x for x,y in p),min(y for x,y in p),max(y for x,y in p)),sorted({grid[x][y] for x,y in p if grid[x][y] not in (0,7)})) for p in comps]
